items.stem: Wang Zhenyi built a simple model of the lunar eclipse ______ the movement of the moon more clearly.
items.rule: 表目的用不定式 to do，可译作「为了……」；不定式不能作谓语。
items.trap: 空前已有谓语 built，别填 explain；表目的用 to do。

items.stem: The teacher asked the students ______ their phones away during the lecture about Internet addiction.
items.rule: ask/tell/want sb to do sth：宾语后接带 to 的不定式。
items.trap: 别按中文「让某人做」漏掉 to，写成 asked the students put。

items.stem: In Wang Zhenyi's time, most girls were made ______ at home instead of going to school.
items.rule: make sb do 变被动为 be made to do，原来省略的 to 必须还原。
items.trap: 主动不带 to、被动要带 to；照抄 made sb do 而漏 to 是最常见错。

items.stem: The water in the pot was too hot ______ with a bare hand, so the cook turned down the heat.
items.rule: too + 形容词 + to do：太……而不能做某事，to 后接动词原形。
items.trap: 别因为前面有 too 就写 doing；too...to 中间是形容词，后面是 to do。

items.stem: By ______ the lunar eclipse herself, Wang Zhenyi proved that it was not a sign from heaven.
items.rule: 介词（by/after/before/without 等）后接动词，一律用动名词 doing。
items.trap: 先看空前是不是介词：By 后只能 doing，别写 to watch 或原形。

items.stem: The boy practises ______ the piano for an hour after school, even on busy days.
items.rule: practise/enjoy/finish/mind/keep 后只接动名词 doing，不接不定式。
items.trap: 受中文「练习弹琴」影响写 practise to play 是高频错，这些词后只跟 doing。

items.stem: Grandma is used to ______ up early, though life in the city is quite different.
items.rule: be used to doing 意为「习惯于做某事」，此处 to 是介词。
items.trap: used to do 是过去常常；be used to 里 to 是介词，后接 doing。

items.stem: Some teenagers are so addicted to ______ online games that they forget their homework.
items.rule: be addicted to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词；so...that 引导结果状语从句。
items.trap: addicted to 后别写 play 或 to play；把它当介词短语，统一用 doing。

items.stem: I clearly remember ______ the door, but now it is open, so I must go back and check.
items.rule: remember doing 记得做过某事；remember to do 记得要做某事。
items.trap: 先看动作是否已发生：句末 now it is open 说明锁过了，用 locking。

items.stem: Don't forget ______ the windows before the storm comes, or the rain will get in.
items.rule: forget to do 忘记要做（还没做）；forget doing 忘记做过。
items.trap: or the rain will get in 说明窗还没关，必须用 to close。

items.stem: Your bike chain is broken and the tyres need ______ before you ride to school.
items.rule: 物作主语时 need doing = need to be done，表示「需要被……」。
items.trap: tyres 自己不会 check；主语是物用 doing 表被动，主语是人用 to do。

items.stem: Our volunteer group ______ old clothes to families in need every winter.
items.rule: 一般现在时中主语为第三人称单数时，谓语动词加 -s/-es。
items.trap: 主语 group 是单数，不随 clothes 变复数；every winter 用现在时。

items.stem: It is well known that water ______ at 100 degrees at sea level.
items.rule: 客观真理、自然规律用一般现在时，不受主句时态影响。
items.trap: 别因前面是 It is 就乱选时态；真理句谓语永远用现在时，还有 -s。

items.stem: Yesterday our class ______ the science museum to learn about ancient inventions.
items.rule: yesterday 等明确过去时间，谓语用一般过去时。
items.trap: 有 yesterday 就不能用 have visited；先找时间状语再定时态。

items.stem: If the temperature ______ below zero tonight, the water in the pot will freeze.
items.rule: if 条件状语从句「主将从现」：从句用一般现在时表示将来。
items.trap: 从句里看到 tonight 也别写 will drop；将来时只出现在主句。

items.stem: Look at the sky! It ______ rain soon, so let's move the plants inside.
items.rule: 说话时有迹象预示将来，用 be going to do；soon 表将来。
items.trap: 有迹象预示将来用 be going to；rains/rained 与 soon 冲突。

items.stem: Jenny ______ the Science Museum twice so far this year, and she says the robot show is fantastic.
items.rule: have been to 去过（人已回来），可与 twice、ever 连用；have gone to 去了未回。
items.trap: so far 要完成时；gone to 不与 twice 连用，经历要用 been to。
items.src: U2 · 复习指引「现在完成时」

items.stem: Mr Chen has taught science in our school ______ 2015, and his students all love his lessons.
items.rule: since + 时间点，for + 时间段；现在完成时常与二者连用。
items.trap: 2015 是时间点该用 since，不是 for；完成时也不与 in 2015 这样搭。
items.src: U2 · 复习指引「现在完成时」

items.stem: Li Wei hasn't finished his science report ______, so he will work on it tonight.
items.rule: yet 用于否定句和疑问句句末；already 多用于肯定句。
items.trap: 否定句句末别填 already；hasn't ... yet 是固定搭配。

items.stem: Jenny ______ the library book since last Monday, so she must return it tomorrow.
items.rule: borrow 是短暂动词，不能与 since/for 连用；延续要用 keep。
items.trap: 「借了两周」直译 has borrowed for 是高频错；有 since 就换成 kept。

items.stem: While I ______ the science report last night, the lights suddenly went out.
items.rule: while 引导的时间状语从句常用过去进行时，表示背景动作正在进行。
items.trap: 别选 wrote：while 后是正在进行的背景动作，突发动作用过去式。

items.stem: The lunar eclipse ______ by millions of people in Guangzhou every year.
items.rule: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词；by 引出动作的执行者。
items.trap: eclipse 是被看的，别选 watches；every year 定现在时，was 排除。
items.src: U1 · 复习指引「被动语态」

items.stem: This kind of paper ______ bamboo, and it is very soft.
items.rule: be made from 指加工后看不出原材料；be made of 指仍看得出原材料。
items.trap: 纸由竹子加工而成、看不出竹子用 from；木桌看得出木头才用 of。
items.src: U2 · 复习指引「被动语态」

items.stem: The first thermometer ______ by a scientist more than 400 years ago, and it changed medicine.
items.rule: 一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词；more than 400 years ago 定过去。
items.trap: 温度计是「被发明」的，别写 invented 主动；有过去时间就用 was。

items.stem: The crown ______ into a bowl of water, and Archimedes watched the water rise.
items.rule: was/were + 过去分词构成过去被动；王冠是「被放入」水中的。
items.trap: put 三形同形，was put 才是被动；别因拼写相同就写成主动 put。

items.stem: A new science museum ______ in our district next year, and students can visit it free.
items.rule: 一般将来时被动：will be + 过去分词。
items.trap: 漏掉 be 就成主动 will build；next year 定将来，was built 排除。

items.stem: So far, more than 200 trees ______ in the school garden by the volunteers.
items.rule: 现在完成时被动：has/have been + 过去分词；so far 定完成。
items.trap: so far 要用 have been done，漏掉 been 就变成主动语态。

items.stem: —Must I hand in the report today? —No, you ______. You can give it to me on Friday.
items.rule: Must I...? 的否定回答用 needn't（不必），不用 mustn't（禁止）。
items.trap: mustn't 是「不许」；回答「不必」用 needn't 或 don't have to。

items.stem: The number of students joining the volunteer club ______ doubled since last year.
items.rule: The number of + 复数名词，中心词是 number，谓语用单数。
items.trap: 别看到 students 就用 have；A number of 才接复数谓语。

items.stem: Neither the students nor their teacher ______ happy about the new timetable at yesterday's meeting.
items.rule: neither...nor 连接主语时，谓语与最近的主语保持一致（就近原则）。
items.trap: 别看到 the students 就选 were；看 nor 后最近的 teacher 定单数。
